title: paeonia delavayi subsp. lutea
intro: Paeonia delavayi subsp. lutea, commonly known as the golden tree peony, is a plant species that belongs to the Paeoniaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation, protecting against cell damage, and regulating immune responses. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia delavayi subsp. lutea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, antispasmodic, and anticonvulsant effects. Further studies are needed to fully elucidate the properties and benefits of this plant species, but it is currently being researched for its potential applications in traditional medicine.
